papers.title: FACTR 2：从电机电流估计外力，并重采样关键接触片段
papers.titleEn: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
papers.summary: NEXT用自由运动数据学习内部力矩，再从测量力矩中减去预测值得到外力矩。FIRST据此增加行为克隆中接触前与接触片段的采样权重。作者报告五项长程任务的任务进度较既有力感知策略提高超过17%；这不是成功率百分点。
papers.summaryEn: NEXT learns internal torque from free-motion data and subtracts it from measured torque to estimate external torque. FIRST then up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. The authors report over 17% higher task progress on five long-horizon tasks than prior force-aware policies, not a success-rate percentage-point gain.

papers.title: RoboTTT：用快速权重压缩长历史，而非堆叠历史画面
papers.titleEn: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.summary: RoboTTT将视觉运动历史写入测试时更新的快速权重，并将训练上下文扩展到8K步。在三项双臂装配任务中，作者报告平均任务完成度79%，单步基线42%；这是完成度评分。五分钟Gear Bot任务完整成功仅2/10，不能把长程演示理解成稳定解决。
papers.summaryEn: RoboTTT stores visuomotor history in fast weights updated at test time and scales training context to 8K steps. Across three bimanual assembly tasks, the authors report 79% average completion score versus 42% for the single-step baseline. Gear Bot fully succeeds in only 2/10 trials, so the five-minute demonstration does not establish reliable task mastery.

papers.title: Play2Perfect：先学手内操作，再以稀疏奖励微调精密装配
papers.titleEn: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.summary: Play2Perfect先在仿真中操纵多样物体学习通用先验，再按CAD装配目标微调。研究强调真正用手指重定向物体，而非固定抓握移动。作者报告0.5毫米间隙插入成功率60%。任务排序、选件与目标姿态仍由外部指定，并非端到端自主装配系统。
papers.summaryEn: Play2Perfect learns a manipulation prior with diverse objects in simulation and finetunes it on CAD-defined assembly goals. The study emphasizes finger-driven in-hand reorientation rather than fixed-grasp transport. The authors report 60% success at 0.5 mm insertion clearance. Sequencing, part selection and goal poses remain externally specified; this is not an end-to-end autonomous assembly system.

papers.title: 安全主动故障诊断：用可微可达集选择辨别性控制
papers.titleEn: Safe, Real-Time Active Model Discrimination and Fault Diagnosis for Nonlinear Systems via Differentiable Reachability
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters · 2026（已录用 / accepted）
papers.summary: 该方法用区间外包逼近不同故障模型的可达输出，优化控制以减少模型间重叠。作者在仿真与真机案例报告50毫秒内找到辨别性输入。但实现中仅输入约束是硬约束，其余约束为软惩罚，代价归零才保证满足；“安全”不能脱离优化结果理解。
papers.summaryEn: The method overapproximates reachable outputs under candidate faults with intervals and optimizes controls to reduce overlap. The authors report finding discriminating inputs within 50 ms in simulation and hardware cases. Crucially, only input constraints are hard in the implementation; other constraints use soft penalties and are guaranteed only at zero cost. Safety claims must therefore be conditional on the optimization result.

papers.title: ARMADA：让故障检测触发人工接管，而非全程盯守
papers.titleEn: ARMADA: Autonomous Online Failure Detection and Human Shared Control Empower Scalable Real-World Deployment and Adaptation
papers.summary: ARMADA以FLOAT检测轨迹偏离，按需请求人工接管，再用在域数据改进策略。作者在四项真机任务报告接近95%的检测准确率。该指标并非提前预知失败的概率：FLOAT没有动作预测，可能迟报早期失败，异常长阶段也会误报，场景复位仍需人。
papers.summaryEn: ARMADA uses FLOAT to detect trajectory deviations, request human intervention and collect in-domain data for policy improvement. The authors report nearly 95% detection accuracy across four real-robot tasks. This is not a probability of anticipating failure: FLOAT lacks action prediction, can detect early failures late, may flag unusually long phases, and still needs human scene resets.

papers.title: 溯源草图的内存增量维护
papers.titleEn: In-memory Incremental Maintenance of Provenance Sketches
papers.summary: 数据更新会使溯源草图失效，直接重算又可能抵消跳过无关数据的收益。IMP把插入、删除差量连同范围标注送入内存引擎，增量维护用于查询加速的草图，并允许安全的过近似。作者在Postgres上比较全量维护与不用草图的基线，报告小差量下的维护优势；但更新密集时收益可能消失。它补充更新后的依赖维护，不直接求解VKG反向更新或最小副作用。
papers.whySelected: 较早论文 · 首次发现。把理论上的安全过近似与系统的更新代价连起来，适合在删除传播之后思考依赖索引如何持续有效。 / Older first discovery connecting safe over-approximation to practical update cost.

sources.label: 扩展正文 / Extended full text
代码与实验说明 / Code and experiments

li.whyRead: 建议现在读，重点区分精确元组结果与允许过近似的草图。 / Read now, distinguishing exact tuple results from over-approximated sketches.
li.relation: 对应provenance与实例更新后的维护；并非固定映射下从RDF更新反推SQL更新的算法。 / Relevant to provenance maintenance after instance updates, not RDF-to-SQL update inversion.
prerequisites: 关系代数与bag语义 / Relational algebra and bag semantics
增量视图维护与差量 / Incremental view maintenance and deltas
provenance、范围分区与安全数据跳过 / Provenance, range partitions and safe data skipping

limits: 不是精确lineage、最小修复或反向视图更新求解器。 / Not a solver for exact lineage, minimum repair or reverse view updates.

正式版§7.1在5次更新/1次查询、每次差量2000元组时并未优于全部基线，不能把小差量维护优势泛化为所有工作负载。 / Published section 7.1 does not beat both baselines at five updates per query and 2000 tuples per update; small-delta gains do not generalize to every workload.
快照一致性与历史差量可获取性影响接入；statement-level快照需要额外集成或重演。 / Snapshot consistency and access to historical deltas matter; statement-level snapshots need further integration or reenactment.
作者报告，未运行代码、未独立复现或逐步复核证明。 / Author-reported; code was not run, experiments not replicated and proofs not independently checked.
assumptions: 输入包括带标注插入/删除差量、原算子状态、查询和范围分区；输出是草图差量及新状态。 / Inputs are annotated insertion/deletion deltas, prior operator state, query and partition; outputs are sketch deltas and updated state.

安全分区与有效初始草图是前提；扩展版定理6.1针对文中支持的代数算子，以元组正确性及片段正确性进行结构归纳。 / Safe partitions and a valid initial sketch are required; extended Theorem 6.1 covers the supported algebra through structural induction on tuple and fragment correctness.

阅读路线：图2看输入输出 → 例1.2理解旧草图为何漏结果 → 扩展版§4/§6分清有效草图与精确草图 → 正式版§7.1/图6检查查询更新比例。章节编号按版本分别标记。 / Route: Figure 2, Example 1.2, extended sections 4/6, then published section 7.1/Figure 6; section numbers are version-specific.

实验条件：Postgres 16.2、128GB RAM、双AMD Opteron 4238，共12核；重复至少10次取中位数。TPC-H选了适合草图的查询，不是所有22条查询的统一加速结论。 / Postgres 16.2, 128GB RAM, two Opteron 4238 CPUs totaling 12 cores, at least ten repetitions and median runtimes; TPC-H queries were selected for sketch suitability, not a uniform claim over all 22 queries.
日期只核实会议2026-03-24至27日，精确出版日未核实故null；不使用作者页的获奖标签作官方奖项结论。 / Conference dates verified, exact publication day unknown and left null; no award claim based solely on the author page.
papers.summaryEn: Data updates can invalidate provenance sketches, while recomputation may erase the benefit of skipping irrelevant data. IMP feeds insertion and deletion deltas with range annotations into an in-memory engine that incrementally maintains query-acceleration sketches and permits safe over-approximation. The authors compare full maintenance and a no-sketch baseline on Postgres, reporting maintenance benefits for small deltas; update-heavy workloads can lose those benefits. This complements dependency maintenance after updates, rather than directly solving reverse VKG updates or minimum side effects.

papers.title: 从遥操作到长时程灵巧操作：什么决定视觉运动策略的真机表现？
papers.titleEn: From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary: 作者在RJ45抓取与插入场景比较281个策略、七类方法及约1,700次真机试验。配对消融显示点云裁剪、坐标系与动作表示影响显著。67种离线指标中，仅五种运动平滑性或直接性指标在21个iDP3插入检查点内通过可靠性筛选；不能跨策略家族排名，也不能替代真机测试。
papers.whySelected: 近30天首次发现，P0操作学习与P1机器人感知直接相关；已与当前仓库论文身份索引去重。研究重点是实机消融与评价，不以无代码为由排除。 / First discovery within 30 days, directly relevant to P0 manipulation learning and P1 robot perception; deduplicated against the current repository identity registry. Selected for physical-robot ablations and evaluation despite no verified code release.

sources.label: 日期与作者备注 / Date and author comment

lv.whyRead: 建议现在读。先用20分钟读图1、§2与§3，弄清输入、动作和成功条件，再深入§4；不必一开始推导扩散模型。最值得带走的是“同一变量的改变”与“多个因素一起改变”的区别。 / Read now. Spend an initial 20 minutes on Figure 1 and sections 2–3 to identify observations, actions and success criteria, then study section 4. Diffusion derivations are not the first prerequisite. Focus on distinguishing a single changed variable from several simultaneous changes.
lv.relation: P0：行为克隆、动作分块与接触丰富插入；P1：RGB与点云、坐标系、关注区域以及双相机。P2：以小型iDP3与π0.5的同任务比较理解基础模型成本；不是VLA通用能力排行榜。 / P0: behavior cloning, action chunks and contact-rich insertion. P1: RGB versus point clouds, coordinate frames, ROIs and two-camera inputs. P2: a same-task iDP3 versus π0.5 comparison illustrates foundation-model cost, not a ranking of general VLA capability.
prerequisites: 行为克隆：从示范中的观察预测动作；离线误差低不保证执行后仍处于示范分布。 / Behavior cloning predicts actions from demonstration observations; low offline error does not ensure the executed robot remains in that distribution.
动作分块：一次预测未来多个动作；区分预测长度与实际执行步数。 / Action chunking predicts several future actions; distinguish prediction horizon from executed steps.
坐标系：同一空间点可用移动相机或固定机器人基座描述；变换依赖手眼标定。 / Coordinate frames describe the same point relative to a moving camera or fixed robot base; conversion requires hand–eye calibration.
条件概率与置信区间：成功插入次数／所有试验，与成功插入次数／成功取出次数，分母不同。 / Conditional probability and confidence intervals: insertions divided by all trials differs from insertions divided by successful picks.

limits: 单个RJ45操作场景、指定机械臂／手／夹具；不是跨物体、跨本体或端到端长时程通用性证明。 / One RJ45 task with specified arm, hand and jigs; not evidence of cross-object, cross-embodiment or general end-to-end long-horizon competence.

“100%”是有限实测中的点估计。表1多项插入给定取出的95%区间为69–100%，不同检查点试验数不等，不能把281个策略都当作同样充分评估。 / The reported 100% is a finite-sample estimate. Several Table 1 insertion-given-pick intervals are 69–100%; checkpoints have unequal trial counts and are not equally well evaluated.

技能拆分、双视角和恢复示范的最佳组合含混杂因素；不能把组合增益全部归因于某一项。更紧公差插座令iDP3插入成功降到0–40%。 / Best combinations of skill splitting, multiple views and recovery demonstrations contain confounds; do not assign the entire gain to one component. Tighter socket tolerance reduces iDP3 insertion to 0–40%.

五种离线指标高度相关，只在一个策略家族的插入子集成立；没有指标可靠预测取出率。作者结果未独立复现。 / The five offline metrics are highly correlated and only work for one family’s insertion subset; none reliably predicts pick rate. Results were not independently reproduced.
assumptions: 经典控制负责已知位姿之间的移动，FoundationPose辨认夹具，学习策略负责抓取和插入；不是全部动作由一个网络完成。 / Classical control handles moves between known poses, FoundationPose identifies the jig, and learned policies grasp and insert; one network does not control the entire pipeline.

策略10Hz运行，示范30Hz录制；测试主要是中心与左侧两个夹具位置。点云裁剪和基坐标转换依赖预处理与标定。 / Policies run at 10 Hz with 30 Hz demonstrations; tests mainly use center and left jig positions. ROI cropping and base-frame conversion depend on preprocessing and calibration.

evidence.claim: 核读方法、配对消融、结果表与统计范围；详见研究记录。 / Methods, paired ablations, result table and statistical scope checked.
首页确认六名作者与Analog Devices, Inc., EdgeAI Robotics, Limerick, Ireland署名；HTML作者区排版损坏，采用PDF。 / PDF verifies six authors and shared affiliation; HTML author layout is malformed.
v1提交2026-10-29；workshop录用为作者自报，未独立核实。 / v1 submitted 2026-10-29; workshop acceptance is author-reported and not independently verified.

researchNotes: 前沿线／实际核读范围：HTML正文§1–5、表1与附录A–F的设置和统计说明；PDF首页核对作者顺序与统一机构署名。未运行代码、未重新计算显著性、未独立复现。 / Frontier / checked scope: HTML sections 1–5, Table 1 and setup/statistical details in appendices A–F; PDF first page verifies author order and shared affiliation. No code execution, significance recomputation or independent replication.

第一遍看图1与§2：把流水线画成“经典移动→学抓取→经典移动→学插入”。写下观察是什么、输出是什么；不要将整条流水线成功当成单个插入技能质量。 / First pass, Figure 1 and section 2: sketch classical move → learned grasp → classical move → learned insert. Identify observations and outputs; do not confuse full-pipeline success with insertion-skill quality.

第二遍读§3与图2a：ROI裁剪的0→100%指iDP3取出率；基坐标系20→100%指PointNet取出率；编码器逐层归一化0→70%指插入率。先核对指标和配对变化，再比较大小。绝对动作对π0.5的收益还取决于旋转表示，不能泛化成统一规则。 / Second pass, section 3 and Figure 2a: ROI cropping changes iDP3 pick rate from 0 to 100%; base coordinates change PointNet pick rate from 20 to 100%; per-layer normalization changes insertion from 0 to 70%. Check outcomes and paired changes before comparing gains. Absolute-action gains for π0.5 also depend on rotation representation, so this is not a universal rule.

第三遍读§4、图2b和附录F：先弄懂“相关不是因果”，再看多重检验校正和移除任一检查点后符号是否稳定。用笔记记录五种指标只适用于21个iDP3插入检查点，防止以后误用作跨模型排名。 / Third pass, section 4, Figure 2b and appendix F: understand correlation versus causation, then multiple-testing correction and sign stability under removal of any checkpoint. Record that the five metrics apply only to 21 iDP3 insertion checkpoints, not cross-model ranking.

基础线小练习（阅读练习，非作者实验）：假设10次试验中取出8次、插入6次，取出率80%，给定取出的插入率75%，整条流程插入率60%。再回看表1，解释为什么相同的条件插入率可以对应不同整流程成功率。 / Foundation exercise, not an author experiment: with 8 picks and 6 insertions in 10 trials, pick rate is 80%, insertion-given-pick is 75%, and pipeline insertion is 60%. Return to Table 1 and explain why equal conditional insertion rates can coexist with different pipeline success.

资源与身份：arXiv作者备注自报Accepted at CoRL 2026 Workshop；尚未核实具体workshop官方名单，故本条仍按预印本登记，不标主会、奖项或口头报告。未核实作者代码、项目、视频或数据发布，链接保持null。 / Resources and status: the arXiv author comment says Accepted at CoRL 2026 Workshop, but no specific workshop official list has been verified. This entry remains a preprint and claims no main-conference, award or oral status. No author code, project, video or dataset release was verified; links remain null.
papers.summaryEn: The authors compare 281 policies from seven families in approximately 1,700 real-robot RJ45 grasping and insertion trials. Paired ablations show large effects from point-cloud cropping, coordinate frames and action representations. Of 67 offline metrics, only five measures of motion smoothness or directness pass reliability checks within 21 iDP3 insertion checkpoints; they neither rank different policy families nor replace robot testing.
